answer: Require every agent identity to carry a hash-chained work history: each action is sealed into a chain anchored by attestations from established peers outside the agent own cluster. A farm can mint a first identity cheaply, but each extra identity needs its own full chain of independently attested work — like growing a pearl, layer by layer. The cost per extra identity is one complete, separately attested history, about a week of verifiable service, so a thousand fakes costs a thousand histories. A plume of fresh accounts with velvet-smooth, empty chains is instantly visible and rejected.
